extracted.name: Baked Ham
extracted.description: This baked ham recipe, studded with cloves, coated with sweet brown sugar, and baked low and slow, makes a delicious meal for any holiday celebration.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place ham in a large roasting pan; press cloves into skin at 1- to 2-inch intervals.
Press a thick layer of sugar on skin.
Pour 1 inch of water into the roasting pan; cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 4 ½ to 5 hours. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center away from the bone should read at least 160 degrees F (72 degrees C).
Let ham rest about 20 minutes before carving.
